meta.title: Leo's Toy Train
meta.textType: counting: numbers to twenty and plurals

paragraphs: Leo comes to Lily's house. He has a big bag. "What is in the bag?" asks Lily. "I have my toys," says Leo. He has a robot. The name of the robot is Beep. He has two teddy bears too. He has a train. The train is green and red.

"How many cars are on the train?" asks Lily. They count the cars. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight! Nine, ten, eleven, twelve, thirteen, fourteen! "Fourteen cars," says Leo. "But my train has fifteen cars!" One car is not here. Leo is sad. Lily looks on the floor. "It is not here," says Lily.

Leo looks in his big bag. He looks under the teddy bears. "Look!" says Leo. It is a small red car! "Hooray!" says Lily. Pip sits next to the bag. "Woof!" says Pip. Leo puts the car on the train. "Now I have fifteen cars!" Then they play with the toys.
text.summary: Leo brings his toys to Lily's house. His train has fifteen cars, but one car is not there. Leo finds it in his bag.
